title: Retail Installment Contracts: Order of Payment Application and Interest Basis
content:
Every contract under Retail Installment Contracts, at every tier from Tier 6 Fresh Start to Tier 1 Select, carries the same order of payment application and the same interest basis.

## Order of application

Each payment other than a payoff is applied to these buckets, in this order:

1. accrued interest;
2. installment principal;
3. fees due;
4. additional principal.

| Tier | Order of application | Interest basis |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | accrued interest, installment principal, fees due, additional principal | actual/365 |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | accrued interest, installment principal, fees due, additional principal | actual/365 |
| Tier 4 Standard | accrued interest, installment principal, fees due, additional principal | actual/365 |
| Tier 3 Advantage | accrued interest, installment principal, fees due, additional principal | actual/365 |
| Tier 2 Preferred | accrued interest, installment principal, fees due, additional principal | actual/365 |
| Tier 1 Select | accrued interest, installment principal, fees due, additional principal | actual/365 |

## Interest basis

Interest is simple interest. The daily rate is the annual percentage rate divided by 365, and it is counted in actual calendar days (the actual/365 basis).

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** On a principal balance of 9125.00 at 21.90%, one day of interest is 21.90% of 9125.00 divided by 365, that is 5.475; thirty actual days come to 164.25.
